name: mahadev-electro-hub
description: Bilingual E-Commerce Website & Admin CMS for Mahadev Electro Hub (Pali, Rajasthan)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server

author: Mahadev Electro Hub
